# `/criteria-config` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### PATCH /criteria-config/v1/privilege/{criteriaConfigId}

`patchPrivilegeCriteriaConfigV1` — Update privilege criteria configuration

Use this API to update the privilege criteria configuration.

- Scopes: sp:gov-criteria:write
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `criteriaConfigId` (path, required) — The Id of the privilege criteria configuration to update.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of object
- Returns 200: privilegecriteriaconfigdto

### GET /criteria-config/v1/privilege/{criteriaConfigId}

`getPrivilegeCriteriaConfigV1` — Get privilege criteria config

Use this API to get the privilege criteria configuration by Id.

- Scopes: sp:gov-criteria:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `criteriaConfigId` (path, required) — The Id of the privilege criteria configuration record to retrieve.
- Returns 200: privilegecriteriaconfigdto

### GET /criteria-config/v1/privilege

`listPrivilegeCriteriaConfigV1` — List privilege criteria config

Use this API to list the privilege criteria configuration.

- Scopes: sp:gov-criteria:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `filters` (query, required) — fields: sourceId: eq — e.g. `sourceId eq "c42c45d8d7c04d2da64d215cd8c32f21"`
- Returns 200: array of privilegecriteriaconfigdto
